effect_description_eng:
When this card would be played, by deleting 1 of your Digimon with [Myotismon] in its text, reduce the play cost by 4.
[On Play] [On Deletion] Until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of your purple Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] You may play 1 purple Tamer card from your trash suspended without paying the cost.
